CITY GENERAL HOSPITAL, KARACHI
VACANCY: REGISTERED NURSE - INTENSIVE CARE UNIT (ICU)

We invite applications for Registered Nurses for our 24-bed adult ICU. The post is permanent, full time, and on site.

Duties include: monitoring of ventilated and critically ill patients, administration of IV medications and infusions, maintaining accurate patient charts, assisting physicians during procedures, and escalating deteriorating patients per protocol.

Qualifications: BSc Nursing (4 years) from a PNC-recognised institution, active PNC registration, valid BLS and ACLS certification. Minimum 3 years of ICU or critical-care experience. Ventilator and central-line care experience is required. Experience with electronic medical records is preferred.

Shifts: rotating 12-hour shifts (day / night), 3-4 shifts per week, including weekends and public holidays.

Salary: PKR 140,000 per month + shift allowance, medical cover for self and family, and annual leave.

Walk-in interview Mon-Fri, HR Dept, 2nd floor. Or email hr@citygeneral.example
